WITH w AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, p.sku, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3)
), r AS (
  SELECT w.sku, sum(rl.refund_net) refund_net, sum(rl.quantity_returned) ret_units
  FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN w ON w.sales_line_id=rl.sales_line_id GROUP BY 1
), a AS (
  SELECT sku, sum(net_amount) net_sales, sum(quantity) units, count(*) n FROM w GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT a.sku, (SELECT product_name FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=a.sku ORDER BY valid_to DESC LIMIT 1) name,
 (SELECT count(distinct product_name) FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=a.sku) nnames,
 a.net_sales, a.units, coalesce(r.refund_net,0) refund_net, a.net_sales-coalesce(r.refund_net,0) net_after_ret,
 rank() over (order by a.net_sales desc) rk_gross, rank() over (order by a.net_sales-coalesce(r.refund_net,0) desc) rk_net
FROM a LEFT JOIN r USING (sku) ORDER BY a.net_sales DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT a.sku, (SELECT product_name FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=a.sku ORDER BY valid_to DESC LIMIT 1) AS pname,
 (SELECT count(distinct product_name) FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=a.sku) AS nnames,
 a.net_sales, a.units, coalesce(r.refund_net,0) AS refund_net, a.net_sales-coalesce(r.refund_net,0) AS net_after_ret,
 rank() over (order by a.net_sales desc) AS rk_gross, rank() over (order by a.net_sales-coalesce(r.refund_net,0) desc) AS rk_net
FROM a LEFT JOIN r USING (sku) ORDER BY a.net_sales DESC LIMIT 15

WITH webs AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, p.sku, f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) OR f.channel_code='WB'
), sales AS (
  SELECT sku, sum(net_amount) AS sales_net, sum(quantity) AS units FROM webs WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03' GROUP BY 1
), refunds AS (
  SELECT w.sku, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN webs w ON w.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  WHERE r.return_date >= DATE '2025-11-03' GROUP BY 1
), t AS (
  SELECT s.sku, s.sales_net, coalesce(f.refund_net,0) AS refund_net, s.sales_net-coalesce(f.refund_net,0) AS net_sales, s.units
  FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds f USING (sku)
)
SELECT t.sku, (SELECT product_name FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=t.sku ORDER BY valid_to DESC LIMIT 1) AS product_name,
  round(t.net_sales,2) AS web_net_sales_eur, t.units, round(t.sales_net,2) AS gross_of_returns, round(t.refund_net,2) AS refunds,
  rank() OVER (ORDER BY t.sales_net DESC) AS rk_before_returns
FROM t ORDER BY t.net_sales DESC LIMIT 12

WITH webs AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, p.sku, f.sale_date, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) OR f.channel_code = 'WB'
), sales AS (
  SELECT sku, sum(net_amount) AS sales_net FROM webs WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03' GROUP BY 1
), refunds AS (
  SELECT w.sku, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN webs w ON w.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  WHERE r.return_date >= DATE '2025-11-03' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.sku,
  (SELECT d.product_name FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku = s.sku ORDER BY d.valid_to DESC LIMIT 1) AS product_name,
  round(s.sales_net - coalesce(f.refund_net, 0), 2) AS web_net_sales_eur
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds f USING (sku)
ORDER BY web_net_sales_eur DESC LIMIT 10
